bill.title: Providing for consideration of the Senate amendment to the concurrent resolution (H. Con. Res. 14) establishing the congressional budget for the United States Government for fiscal year 2025 and setting forth the appropriate budgetary levels for fiscal years 2026 through 2034, and for other purposes.
bill.latestActionText: Pursuant to the provisions of H.Res. 707, H.Res. 313 is amended.
bill.officialSummary: This resolution provides for the consideration of the Senate amendment to H. Con. Res. 14, which establishes the congressional budget for the federal government for FY2025 and sets forth budgetary levels for FY2026-FY2034.

classification.plainSummary:
This resolution provides for the consideration of the Senate amendment to H. Con. Res. 14, which establishes the congressional budget for the federal government for FY2025 and sets forth budgetary levels for FY2026-FY2034.

This is a internal procedural measure ("Providing for consideration of"). It carries no sector tags and no donor overlap is computed for it, because attributing an economic interest to a commemorative or procedural measure would be misleading.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
